provider_agreement_ready.subject: Your Provider Agreement Is Ready To Sign
provider_agreement_ready.headline: Your Provider Agreement
provider_agreement_ready.body: Welcome to Hols. To complete your onboarding, please review and sign your provider agreement.
provider_agreement_ready.body_secondary: Once signed, we'll set up your account and send you a link to create your login credentials.
provider_agreement_ready.footer_note: If you have any questions, our support team is here to help.

otp_verification.subject: Your HOLS login verification code
otp_verification.headline: Your verification
otp_verification.body: Use the code below to finish signing in to your HOLS account. Do not share this code with anyone.
otp_verification.body_secondary: If you did not request this code, you can ignore this email.
otp_verification.notice: Your verification code is {{otp_code}}. It expires in {{expiry_minutes}} minutes.
otp_verification.footer_note: If you have any questions, our support team is here to help.

affiliate_account_created.subject: Your HOLS affiliate account
affiliate_account_created.headline: Your affiliate account
affiliate_account_created.body: Your HOLS affiliate account has been created. Use the details below to sign in.
affiliate_account_created.body_secondary: Please log in and change your password if required by your account policy.
affiliate_account_created.footer_note: If you have any questions, our support team is here to help.

invite_to_join.subject: You are invited to join HOLS
invite_to_join.headline: You're invited
invite_to_join.body: {{inviter_name}} invited you to join House of Life Sciences. Create your account with the button below.
invite_to_join.body_secondary: If you were not expecting this invite, you can ignore this email.
invite_to_join.footer_note: If you have any questions, our support team is here to help.
